title: Felt & Velvet 4AM
description: A slow-burning, chord-led 2-step roller built on felt piano stabs and a chopped soul-vocal pad. Broken 808 kicks shuffle under shoulder-swung hats while the pads pump with the beat; the progression deepens and the filter blooms as it climbs toward a euphoric, nocturnal peak before settling back to a quiet piano outro.
